title: FAQ Accordion
content: Create FAQ accordion component. Structure: list of questions with expandable answers. Single/multi: allow one or multiple open at once. Icons: ChevronDown rotates when expanded. Animation: smooth height expansion. Search: filter questions by keyword. Categories: group FAQs by topic with tabs or headings. Anchor links: each question has shareable URL. Answer content: support rich text and images in answers. Popular: highlight frequently viewed questions. Feedback: "Was this helpful?" rating. Contact: "Still need help?" CTA at bottom.

variants.simple: Build FAQ section with expandable question/answer pairs.
variants.detailed: Create FAQ accordion component. Structure: list of questions with expandable answers. Single/multi: allow one or multiple open at once. Icons: ChevronDown rotates when expanded. Animation: smooth height expansion. Search: filter questions by keyword. Categories: group FAQs by topic with tabs or headings. Anchor links: each question has shareable URL. Answer content: support rich text and images in answers. Popular: highlight frequently viewed questions. Feedback: "Was this helpful?" rating. Contact: "Still need help?" CTA at bottom.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive FAQ section with search, categories, and accessibility. Structure: array of {question, answer, category?, id} objects. Accordion behavior: single-open (only one answer visible) or multi-open (independent), configurable. Animation: CSS transition on max-height or grid-template-rows: 0fr to 1fr for smooth expand. Icons: ChevronDown with rotate-180 transition when expanded, aria-hidden on icon. Accessibility: button trigger with aria-expanded and aria-controls, answer region with id, proper focus management. Search/filter: search input filters visible questions by keyword match in question/answer, live filtering as user types, show result count, clear button. Categories: group by topic (Billing, Account, Features), display as tabs, sidebar links, or accordion sections with headers. URL anchors: each question has unique id, hash navigation (#faq-billing-cancel), open and scroll to question on page load with matching hash. Rich answers: support markdown or HTML in answers, images, lists, links, code blocks. "Was this helpful": Yes/No buttons per answer, tracks feedback for analytics. Popular/trending: show most viewed FAQs at top, track views via analytics. Related questions: show related FAQs based on category or tags. Schema markup: add FAQPage structured data for SEO. Empty search: friendly message with suggestions or contact link. Contact CTA: "Cannot find what you are looking for?" with link to support.
